decisions.statement: The census is names rather than receivers.
The census is written as numbered runs with an aggregate composing those runs.
A run's ordinal carries at least two digits and as many as the count of runs needs.
A clone with no colon-method refuses the call.
The command remains while nothing reads the census that command would make.
The writing call that lands the staged bodies is named instead.
The staging folder is named as soon as this made it.
Each body staged is named as soon as that body is written.
A run that threw part way names in its refusal what it had staged.
An argument this command does not take is refused rather than passed over.
A test seam is taken after the world, so a real call reaches the work.

definition: the command staging the census of the method names the base game defines on a class
